cost_boundary: Entire six-GPU allocation, including service, startup, idle time and cleanup; not just candidate execution. Shared historical warm-start construction and adapter training are not credited as zero-cost E2E learning.
decision: Stop automatic expansion of this preselected metric-step30 deployment recipe. No new seeds, checkpoint reselection, threshold revision or rescue rerun.
result_boundary: Both denoising repeats have worse pool-best RMSE than both concurrent old references; median is also worse than old-medium in both repeats. Aerial improves against both references in repeat 0 and regresses against both in repeat 1. This does not establish universal failure of policy training or a reward-function causal effect.
history_boundary: Same pinned initial program, visible history and public preview; matched real first prompts; no transfer of newly accumulated history across pools. Only conditional deployment gain is tested.
replication_boundary: Two reverse-order resource-pool repeats share one service/allocation and reused development tasks. Forty-eight trajectories are not forty-eight independent trials; no official test/generalization or training-cost ROI claim.
verification_boundary: Frozen remote Python independently recomputed submission scores against external development references; pre-frozen local Node verifier separately checked run matrix, CSV/JSON consistency, contrasts, pool medians and SDs, receipts, modes and original gate. Node did not reread raw prediction files or labels.
